title: Anthropic says Opus 5 model "is the least susceptible to being tricked into misuse"; it is Anthropic's fourth model release in less than two months (Madison Mills/Axios)

contentText:
Madison Mills / Axios :

Anthropic says Opus 5 is the company's “most aligned model to date”; it is Anthropic's fourth model release in less than two months   —  Anthropic on Thursday is releasing Claude Opus 5, a new AI model designed to deliver performance close to its most powerful model, Fable, on many tasks at half the price, the company said.
